Batu Hijau sold 584,700 ounces of gold in 2003 (328,900 equity ounces). Batu Hijau was
accounted for by the equity method in 2003. Had Batu Hijau been consolidated in 2003, Costs applicable to sales would have been $119 per ounce and Depreciation, depletion and amortization would have been $55 per ounce.
